# Brower Inc.

> Brower Inc. is a locally owned portable sanitation and septic services company based in Newkirk, Oklahoma, serving 14 counties across Oklahoma and southern Kansas. Licensed, insured, and owner-operated by Troy Brower since 2007. Phone: (580) 747-6206.

## Services

- [Portable Restrooms](https://browerinc.net/services/portable-restrooms): Standard and ADA-accessible porta potty rental (Maxim 300 units) — events, construction, oil field. Pricing $125-$250/month long-term, $100-$200/event short-term
- [VIP Shower & Restroom Trailers](https://browerinc.net/services/vip-shower-restroom-trailers): Luxury climate-controlled trailers with private stalls, vanities, and running water — weddings, galas, corporate events. $800-$2,500 per event
- [Hand Washing Stations](https://browerinc.net/services/hand-washing-stations): Standalone hand washing units, foot-pump operated, no plumbing hookups required — required by OSHA at most construction sites
- [Septic Services](https://browerinc.net/services/septic-services): Septic tank pumping, cleaning, repair, and installation. Standard pumping $200-$500 depending on tank size and access
- [Long-Term Rentals](https://browerinc.net/services/long-term-rentals): Weekly, monthly, yearly portable restroom rental with weekly servicing included. Standard for construction, oil & gas, agriculture, and disaster relief

## Industries Served

- [Construction](https://browerinc.net/industries/construction): OSHA 1926.51-compliant porta potty rental for Oklahoma construction sites — calculator, ADA, hand wash, fines guide
- [Events & Weddings](https://browerinc.net/industries/events-weddings): Luxury VIP trailers, standard porta potties, and hand wash stations for weddings, festivals, galas, rodeos
- [Oil & Gas](https://browerinc.net/industries/oil-gas): Drilling-site sanitation, pipeline construction, wind farm logistics — long-term rentals, 24/7 service
- [Agriculture](https://browerinc.net/industries/agriculture): Harvest crews, ranch operations, farm sanitation — multi-week and seasonal rentals
- [Government & Municipal](https://browerinc.net/industries/government-municipal): Public works, parks, road construction, polling places, municipal events
- [Disaster Relief](https://browerinc.net/industries/disaster-relief): Tornado, ice storm, and flood emergency response — 24/7 deployment and FEMA-compatible billing
- [Film & TV Production](https://browerinc.net/industries/film-tv): Mobile crew sanitation for Oklahoma film productions, location shoots, and commercial sets
- [Real Estate](https://browerinc.net/industries/real-estate): Open houses, model home staging, vacant property servicing
- [Utilities & Telecom](https://browerinc.net/industries/utilities-telecom): Line crew restrooms for utility, fiber, and telecom field work

## Blog

- [My Septic Tank Hasn't Been Pumped in 12 Years — Am I in Trouble?](https://browerinc.net/blog/septic-tank-never-pumped-oklahoma): Whether years without pumping already damaged the system, how to tell today, and the $400-vs-$20,000 cost math for Oklahoma homeowners
- [Porta Potty Reeks of Ammonia in the July Heat — Normal or Skipped Service?](https://browerinc.net/blog/porta-potty-smells-like-ammonia-summer-oklahoma): Why Oklahoma summer heat makes units smell, a 30-second check for whether your provider is skipping service, and why frequency — not a new unit — is the fix
- [5 Warning Signs Your Septic Tank Needs Pumping](https://browerinc.net/blog/signs-septic-tank-needs-pumping-oklahoma): Slow drains, gurgling, greener or soggy grass over the drain field, sewage odor, and backups — what each means, how urgent it is, and the cost of ignoring them
- [My Barn Wedding Venue Only Has 2 Bathrooms for 200 Guests](https://browerinc.net/blog/barn-wedding-not-enough-bathrooms-oklahoma): How many restrooms an Oklahoma barn or ranch wedding needs, luxury porta potty vs. restroom trailer, real 2026 costs, and protecting the farmhouse septic

- [Emergency Portable Restroom Deployment in Oklahoma](https://browerinc.net/blog/emergency-portable-restroom-deployment-oklahoma): Disaster-response sanitation after tornadoes, ice storms, and floods — speed, unit counts, the 5-step deployment process, and standing agreements
